name: Cozumel
subtitle: Some of the very best diving anywhere in the Caribean, this easily accessible Destination has something for everyone.
isoTitle: Iberostar Waves Cozumel with Dressel Divers
isoDesc: All-inclusive beachfront resort with on-site dive center and easy access to daily boat dives.
summary: Classic Caribbean drift diving with easy logistics and consistent conditions. Expect warm water, short boat rides, and multiple daily dive windows with relaxed surface intervals.

resort.name: Iberostar Waves Cozumel
resort.description: All-inclusive beachfront resort with Dressel Divers onsite for daily boats, gear support, nitrox availability, and effortless schedules for multi-dive days.

seasonality: Year-round; best clarity in winter and spring. Summer brings warmer water and calmer seas, with occasional brief storms late summer.
logistics: Fly into CUN and ferry to Cozumel or take direct CZM flights. Plan 1-2 hours for transfers plus ferry timing; passport required.
experience: Open Water is fine for reefs; Advanced recommended for deeper walls and stronger currents.
narrative: Cozumel delivers effortless drift dives over bright reefs and walls with easy boat access and reliable schedules. Short rides mean more time in the water and flexible surface intervals. Stay at Iberostar Waves Cozumel and walk straight to the boats for a smooth, dive-heavy trip without complicated logistics.

Extras: day trips, food, culture, shore adventures, non-diver friendly.

name: Lake Michigan
subtitle: One of the greatest of the Great Lakes, full of history. Lake Michigan is full of natural (not artificial) shipwrecks. Some dating back to the 1800s!
isoDesc: Hands down the best six-pack dive charter on Lake Michigan.

A small-boat charter and solid planning unlock crisp visibility and history-rich dives. Expect precise briefings, colder temps, and big-lake conditions that reward experienced divers.

Dive style: deeper profiles, slower ascents, line work.
Logistics: charter schedules and weather windows matter.
Extras: charter options, training progression.
